messages:
Marcus: Quick sync re: the metering postmortem follow-ups (delayed usage ingest + token-count mismatch). I want concrete owners, short timelines, and one coord meeting if needed. Keeping this thread for async updates :point_down:
Sara: FYI summary of open items I pulled from the postmortem notes:
- backfill delayed usage into ledger (owner: Alex, ETA: Wed EOD)
- token-count reconciliation across ingest pipeline (owner: Jia, ETA: EOW)
- invoice reissue / credit memos to affected customers (owner: Ella / finance ops, ETA: Thu AM)
- monitoring/alerting for ingestion-lag and token-drop (owner: Priya, ETA: next Wed)
Can owners confirm or update? :calendar:
Alex: I can take the backfill. Plan:
1) run reconciler job against raw-usage (nightly-window)
2) apply safe-delta to ledger with idempotency check
3) post a summary CSV + sample invoices for Ella to review
I'll kick the job tonight and drop logs here. SQL I'm running for a smoke check:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_raw, SUM(tokens_accounted) AS tokens_ledger
FROM usage_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(tokens)-SUM(tokens_accounted)) > 1000;
```
ETA: backfill completion Wed 23:59 UTC. @Ella please confirm if that timeline works for billing cutover.
Jia: I'll own the token audit. Two parts: reconciliation + root-cause sampling. Plan:
- run sampling script across the Kafka partitions to find where token stats diverge
- produce a per-model/week delta table and surface top 20 customers affected
Command I'll run (sandbox first):
```bash
python tools/token_audit.py --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-15 --output s3://redwood-postmortem/token-audit-196789
```
Need temp creds for the audit job (Alex, can you share read-only creds to the raw topic?)
Ella: Timeline works. I'll prepare credit memos once Alex posts the backfill CSV. Notes:
- Need a short blurb for affected customers explaining the correction (I can draft)
- Ops/legal sign-off needed for credits above $Xk — I'll route internally.
Priya: I'll add an alert to Prometheus and a Grafana panel for ingestion lag + token-skew. Runbook will include rollback and escalation to eng-sre. Link to draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-lag (please comment). ETA next Wed for alert in prod, can do a canary in staging earlier.
ingest-bot: scheduled-job: reconciler-job started for window 2026-03-01..2026-03-15 (job_id=rbw-1967). Logs will stream to #eng-infra.
Marcus: Couple of coordination asks:
- Alex/Jia: add a short checklist when you post results (CSV, sample invoices, top 20 customers, root cause hypothesis)
- Ella: once credits are drafted pls add expected GL impact and target billing dates
- Priya: add a severity->pager mapping to the runbook so CS knows when to escalate to oncall
If things stay on track, no extra meeting. If any ETA slips >24h let's convene a 30m sync. Check-in here by EOD tomorrow for status. :thumbsup:
Alex: Will post job logs + reconciliation CSV here when done (I'll ping the thread).
Jia: I'll start the sampling against staging now and post the first delta table by EOD.
Ella: Draft credit memo will be here by Thu 09:00 PT.
Priya: I'll open the alert PR today and link it for review.
Marcus: Thanks all — please add yourself as owner in the postmortem action tracker (doc link in the original postmortem). I'll close the loop next Fri with a short summary for execs.
